parameters.content:
## Client onboarding intake with welcome email and internal alert
New client fills in an intake form. They get a welcome email with next steps and your team gets the details.

## Setup (about 10 minutes)
1. Make a Google Sheet with a tab named **Clients** and paste the header row from `sheet-headers.csv` (first row).
2. Open **Settings** and fill in your sheet URL, email and names.
3. Connect your accounts on every node with a warning (Google Sheets, Gmail).
4. Fill in the built-in form (open the form URL from the **Form** node).
5. Click **Execute workflow**, send a test, then switch the workflow to **Active**.
